app.title: Trustworthy Process Monitor
app.tagline: Data reliability with a human in the loop. Raw data stays on this machine.

role.pick.operator: What is wrong, where, what to do, how sure we are.
role.pick.engineer: Adds evidence tables, signal contributions, detector details and relations.
role.pick.reviewer: Adds the decision log, hash-chain verification, egress ledger and overrides audit.

runs.orPath: or the path of a file already on this machine

dq.bannerFail: Data cannot be trusted for {signals} in {batches}.
dq.bannerWarn: Data is usable with caution in {n} batches.
dq.bannerOk: All {n} batches pass the trust checks.
dq.rulesIntro: Write a rule the way you would say it. The system compiles it into a check, explains what it understood and how sure it is. Nothing runs before you approve it.

mon.title: Drift and anomalies over time

mon.rawSeries: Signals behind this flag (raw, local only)
mon.detectors: Detectors and how they were chosen
diag.title: Diagnoses
diag.pick: Pick a diagnosis to see the full explanation.
ass.title: Is this data fit for its purpose?
ass.chatPlaceholder: Would adding more data help? Which regime is thin?
ass.uploadHelp: Upload a file to estimate what it would add. Nothing is applied without approval.
log.title: Every decision, in order
log.intro: Inferences, flags, checks, rules, model calls and human decisions, hash-chained so that nothing can be altered afterwards without breaking the chain.
log.bad: Chain broken at entry {seq} after {n} good entries.
flow.title: What leaves this machine
flow.noLedger: No model calls recorded for this run.
rep.title: Report
rep.generating: Generating the report in {lang}… this takes a few seconds.
rep.llmPending: The report in {lang} is ready and shown below. The language model is still writing its summary (usually under a minute); the preview reloads when it is added.
rep.llmNone: It does not include a model-written summary (the language model is unavailable or did not answer in time); everything else is complete.
rep.failed: The report in {lang} could not be generated:
rep.regenerateHelp: Build the report again from the current artifacts
rep.capped: Large run: the report lists the {shown} most severe of {total} {what}.
chat.title: Ask about it
chat.placeholder: Ask in your own words: why? which sensor? what should I do?
chat.empty: Ask a question, or click any flag to start from its evidence.
stream.title: Live input
stream.replay: Replay this file as a stream
stream.watch: Watch a folder for new files
ref.notFound: {id} was not found in this run.
ref.subject: About
evidence.missing: Evidence {ids} is not in the registry of this run. If the run just finished, reload the page; if it is still processing, wait for it.
evidence.missingAny: {ids} could not be found in this run. If the run just finished, reload the page; if it is still processing, wait for it.
plain.shareHelp: The bars show how much of the deviation each signal accounts for; 100 % would mean a single signal.
mon.scoreHelp: The line is the combined anomaly score of all detectors; the dashed line is the level considered normal. Markers are flags.
dq.trustHelp: Trust score: the share of the data that passed the checks; below the threshold a batch is not used for detection.
dq.pickBatch: Click a bar to see one batch and its checks.
dq.checksHelp: Each row is one check on one batch. Click a row to ask about it; ids in the text are links.
diag.why.process: Several related signals moved together and kept their usual relations: the disturbance is in the process, not in one instrument.
diag.why.sensor: One signal broke its usual relation to its partners while the partners stayed consistent: the instrument, not the process, is the likely cause.
diag.why.data: The change is a data artefact (scale, duplicates, gaps), not a physical event.
diag.why.mixed: Both a process disturbance and an instrument problem remain plausible.
diag.why.unknown: The evidence does not favour a process or a sensor explanation.
diag.verdictHelp.supported: The critique found no objection; the confidence stands.
diag.verdictHelp.weakened: The critique raised objections; the confidence was lowered.
diag.verdictHelp.rejected: The critique found the diagnosis unconvincing; treat it as a hypothesis only.
ass.gainHelp: about {n} points more {metric} on a 0–100 scale
ass.scoreHelp: combined from fitness, coverage and data quality
ass.compHelp: Each component is a 0–100 % score; the weight says how much it counts in the combined score.
ass.action.add_more_like: Collect more data of the same kind
ass.learningCurveHelp: How {metric} grows as more of the data is used; a curve still rising means more data would help.
ass.coverageHelp: Share of the data in each operating regime; a thin regime is one the models have rarely seen.
ass.dqHelp: Share of batches passing each family of checks.
ass.diminishing: diminishing returns from {p} of the data
ass.noThin: No thin regime: every operating state is well represented.
ass.recHelp: Each recommendation names its expected effect and evidence. Nothing is applied before you approve it.
ass.chatHelp: Ask in your own words; the answer is built from the numbers above and cites its evidence.
runs.demoStarted: Demo run {id} started on {src}; the real pipeline is running.
